answer.label: In short
answer.lead: White-label creative, video and UGC means MMC produces the design and content your agency sells: ad creative, social graphics, video edits and creator-style videos, made to your client's brand rules and returned in the formats you need. It covers the busy weeks when your own designers are full.

stages.breaks: The brief says make it pop.
stages.why: A vague brief means three rounds of guessing and a late file.
stages.does: We rewrite it as one page of hook, angle, must-show and must-say, and send it back for your yes.

stages.why: Open-ended feedback turns a fixed job into unpaid time.
stages.does: Rounds are agreed up front, feedback is gathered into one list per round, and extras are quoted to you first.

stages.breaks: Brand rules are checked after the file is made.
stages.why: A wrong font or colour reaches the client and costs trust.
stages.does: Every file is checked against the client's brand sheet before it is sent to you.

stages.why: A cut made for one platform does not fit another, and your team is cropping at midnight.
stages.does: We deliver each cut in the formats on the brief, named in one convention.

stages.why: A messy folder slows your team and invites mistakes.
stages.does: Deliveries arrive in a tidy folder with a note on what is final and what is a draft.
